## S6 closeout — finite-d error, rank-one certificate, spectral residual, cohort composition (2026-10-19)

Intake: newest Dropbox/Drive objects were the 3694d6e1 recovery ZIP; PR head was 3694d6e; no newer results → no completed campaign was repeated.

Commits: `18a4f96` (code, tests, pinned spectral preregistration R2), `04a3a85` (runs, reviews, state; archived), `a9704c6` (cloud readback receipt only). Tree of 04a3a85: `aa11a61e5d93c555e4868b6222a8179c1a8cf3ee`. Existing verified sources (angular_*.py, balance*.rs, native_*.rs, run_native_adapter.py) unchanged. Owner `rei_bianchi@0e25846` compiled unchanged.

**S6a finite-d.** Exact identity `A_α−A_iso = Σ_ℓ k_ℓ(d) M_ℓ / F_α`; branch-point ellipse `ρ(d)=√coth(3|d|/2)`; rigorous Legendre tail (modulo non-interval 30-digit quadrature + 1e-25 floor). On the 146 stored rules / 1460 points: stored A_error reproduced to 2.2e-16, tail(L=100) ≤ 1.0e-22, sign-free bound and theorem (S6.4) hold (910 pts, min margin 3.47). Moment constraints alone improve the guaranteed bound only ≈ρ(d)² per order (sufficient, not sharp; at d=0.2 P2…P24 suffice for 1e-6). P2→P24 change = targeted ℓ=4 term + ℓ≥6 collateral (≤47%); 44/238 above-noise pairs got worse via removed cancellation.
Refinement rate `ρ*=min(ρ(b),ρ(b+d))`: **preregistered gate G5 FAILED** (38/344, all pre-asymptotic 2n lnρ* ≤ 6.38) and is kept; disjoint held-out grid PASS (30 asymptotic pairs, ratio 0.78–1.005; P2/P24 asymptotics only weakly tested).

**S6b rank-one.** `rank1_certificate.project_rank1` with exact integer-quadratic certificate (Fraction checks, 2^-48 binding window, unchanged 3e-15 gate). GL4 → Gauss weights (Δ≤1.7e-16). Python only; native grids never rank-one; no real campaign use.

**S6c spectral residual.** `5.369926725506957e-12` = owner Simpson-32 cell-mean truncation in the *reference* (`axbi_sources.rs`) vs GL8 deposition (`source_moments`, within 1e-16 of 40-digit); max is +1 ulp of 5.369704680902032e-12. Native 26-row panel×bin + angular run: native−prediction ≤ 2.2e-16, doubling ratio 16.0–16.25, bin/angle independent. run02 under git-committed preregistration R2 gave identical native output SHA256. Scope: source deposition only.

**S6d cohorts.** Prescribed geometry, frozen weights: conservation identity 3.0e-15, birth quadrature O(Δu²) (3.90–4.03), angular part separated. Leading P4 source-age formula off by 1.3–2.1× (direction geometry/time dependent). Coupled Einstein/shear: **not run**; `ds/dt+3Hs=(8πG/3c²)ΔP` matches owner `omitted_feedback`; contract in `evidence_s6/COUPLED_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT.json`.

Failures kept: G5 preregistered; source-age attempt0 implementation failure (truncated receipt renamed + NOTE); test-design errors fixed. Independent code + theory reviews: all findings fixed or reworded (`evidence_s6/INDEPENDENT_*_REVIEW.md`). Tests: `test_s6` 22 PASS. Resources: ≤10 workers, peak RSS 335 MB, longest job 27 s; NCP not used.

**Dual backup.** `BASS_S6_FINITE_D_RANK1_SPECTRAL_COHORT_20261019_04a3a851.zip`, 927047 bytes, SHA256 `93ae03207b9c1fcccba56b4ec6cd22408f9f03fb7a86e5dec72fe62793915ea1`, 86 payloads. Dropbox `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_QpA`, Drive `1U6t-M8w-8CvJrE0fyakOcqoWHhLP-GZL`. Both independently raw-downloaded: byte-equal, SHA256/CRC, manifest 86/86; Dropbox content hash and Drive md5 match; connector metadata confirmed.

Remaining: coupled feedback run, native source-age composition, transport/absorption/history spectral convergence, measured impact of n_mu≤32 for max(|b|,|b+d|)≳0.6. No production / full EoR / merge. PR stays draft.
